rationale: param_efficient-claude-agentic: reg_type=bilateral, bilateral_on_top=False, proj_filter_on=False, n_iter=30, learnable_alpha=True, alpha_init=0.1, foe_n_filters=24, foe_kernel=7, foe_n_bumps=31, n_bf=1, bf_multiscale=True, bf_sigmas=[0.8, 1.6, 3.2], bf_kernel=7, bf_sigma_r=0.02, bf_gain_init=0.0, epochs=16, cosine_lr=True, lr=0.005, max_train_s=1080, batch_size=4, train_n=200, val_n=200, display_min=0.0, display_max=0.05, seed=42, rationale=iter-23 param_efficient breast -- WU-COMBINATION #1: BAND-WEIGHTED filtered-DC (frequency-selective DC, solver edit). SIX-BOX: (1) PRIOR: champion = LPD-combine W=4 filtered-DC K=30 = 0.5047 @ 183p (seed42). The filtered-DC applies a UNIFORM ramp/Hann filter fbp(Rx-g) EVERY step; but sparse-view streaks have a characteristic spectral signature a learned per-band weighting could target. Wu-init (iter-22) was a null for INITIALIZATION, but Wu's distinctive value is FREQUENCY-BAND SELECTIVITY, which the uniform ramp lacks. (2) FAILURE MODE: uniform ramp-filtered DC cannot down-weight streak-frequency components while preserving detail-frequency. (3) ONE KNOB (architectural): dc_mode 'filtered'->'band' -- I added a BandWeightedDC module: it reweights the residual spectrum by Sum_i s_i*tri_i(f) (tri_i = triangular partition-of-unity band windows, Sum tri_i=1) BEFORE the projector's fbp. s_i init 1.0 => reweight == identity => dc == fbp(resid) == the 0.5047 champion BYTE-FOR-BYTE at init (no regression). +6 band-scale params -> 189 total. All else byte-for-byte iter-15 (LPD W=4, K=30, seed42). (4) HYPOTHESIS: a learned per-band DC filter lets each of the K=30 DC corrections down-weight the streak-frequency band while preserving fibroglandular detail frequencies -> hr climbs past 0.5047, because frequency-selectivity is a lever uniform filtered-DC lacks. OR the s_i train back toward 1.0 (uniform ramp already captures the useful spectrum) -> clean null. (5) BUDGET: band reweight = 1 FFT/iFFT per step (cheap); iter-15 finished 16ep in 1020s -> expect ~14-16ep; train_n=200, max_train_s=1080, --time=00:30:00, 200-val -> 20-min comparable. (6) SERIAL; iter-24: if band-DC helps, tune n_bands; else try Wu band-selective PROX (#2) or report the null; then finish champion seed replicates., dc_mode=band, per_step_alpha=True, lpd_on=True, lpd_width=4, lpd_kernel=3, anisotropic_on_top=False, band_dc_n_bands=6
